Hi, I’m Rey Joseph “RJ” Nieto.

I am a mathematician, university instructor, and communications professional.
I hold a First Class Honours BSc in Mathematics from the
[University of Bristol](https://www.bristol.ac.uk/news/2026/june/university-of-bristol-ranked-8th-in-uk-in-latest-qs-world-university-rankings.html)
in England and currently teach general-education information technology and
mathematics at Bulacan State University (BulSU) in the Philippines. Before
returning to formal study, I worked across journalism, broadcasting, public
affairs, technical writing, and government communications. Here are my
[CV](cv/index.qmd), my [BSc project on computational
topology](https://github.com/reyjosephnieto/ph/blob/main/Nieto_TDA_Public_20260430.pdf){target="_blank" rel="noopener"},
its [GitHub repository](https://github.com/reyjosephnieto/ph), and my
[LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/reyjosephnieto/).
:::
